item.title: As electricity costs rise, everyone wants data centers to pick up their tab. But how?
item.description: The demand for electricity can have a ripple effect that raises prices for everyone else. For example, if utilities build more power plants or transmission lines to serve them, the cost can be spread across all ratepayers.

item.title: Democrats introduce bill to protect Gordie Howe Bridge from Trump threats
item.description: The proposed legislation follows comments by former President Donald Trump on Truth Social Monday night, where he suggested the bridge’s opening could be halted unless Canada agrees to compensate the United States.

item.title: Ziare Wells scores 19 in Oakland’s 93-69 loss to Robert Morris, as skid hits 3 games
item.description: Nikolaos Chitikoudis’ 20 points helped Robert Morris defeat Oakland 93-69 on Sunday.

item.title: Syla Swords scores 24, No. 7 Michigan beats No. 13 Michigan State 86-65 to sweep season series
item.description: Syla Swords had 24 points and Olivia Olson scored 23, helping No. 7 Michigan beat No. 13 Michigan State 86-65 on Sunday to sweep the season series.

item.title: Tyler Reddick wins the Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan-owned 23XI Racing
item.description: Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win.

item.title: Lucas Raymond has starred for Sweden at the Olympics in Milan
item.description: A budding star with the Detroit Red Wings in his fourth NHL season, Lucas Raymond has elevated his game to an entirely different level with Sweden at the Olympics.

item.title: US beats Germany to stay unbeaten at the Olympics, but Canada is the top seed
item.description: Matthew Tkachuk insists he and his U.S. teammates were only focused on beating Germany in their preliminary round finale and never worried about scoring enough goals to pass Canada for the top seed at the Olympics.

item.title: Tigers prospect opens up about grief, growth and lessons from a tough season
item.description: Detroit Tigers catching prospect Thayron Liranzo lost 35 pounds this winter after the team challenged him to reshape his body.

item.title: Pistons-led USA Stars team wins new-look NBA All-Star game
item.description: The USA Stars — featuring Cade Cunningham, Jalen Duren and the entire Pistons’ coaching staff led by J.B. Bickerstaff — took the top prize in the first three-team edition of the event, after besting many of the elite players in the NBA in a four-game tournament.
